description.p: Photo views and edits one image at a time: read its camera details and location, rotate, crop, resize, adjust the colours and apply filters.

Draw on photos with a smooth pen, a highlighter, arrows, lines, rectangles, ellipses and text, and blur or pixelate private details. Drawings stay editable until you save, and are then flattened into the image at full resolution, keeping the camera details.
Albums, favorites, slideshows and import live in Gallery.
Developed by the DebION Dev-Team for the Selviana Desktop Environment.
